name: vintage-film-red-dress-mirror-selfie
image_vibe: Intimate cinematic backstage glamour, crimson vintage film, warm tungsten haze
image_purpose: Create a nostalgic backstage mirror-selfie with rich red fashion and analog texture.

prompt.project_info: A 35mm film mirror-selfie portrait in a dim intimate dressing room or backstage area.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with voluminous soft Hollywood waves and feathered curtain fringe, natural flyaways, dreamy partially closed eyes, and dewy realistic skin. She wears an intricate red lace corset-style top with crimson sequins and silver bead accents, paired with a matching layered ruffled sequin miniskirt and satin ribbon waistband, styled with secure opaque coverage.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level mirror reflection, right arm raised holding a vintage compact silver camera, left hand near the collarbone, dark textured walls, blurred equipment cases and clothing racks, and subtle motion blur.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm hazy tungsten light, soft highlight bloom, deep warm shadows, intimate cinematic nostalgia, and crimson red against black, charcoal, and amber tones.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm wide-angle prime, f/2.0, soft background bokeh, Kodak Portra 400-inspired analog grain, photorealistic RAW texture, gentle film softness.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic 35mm film mirror-selfie portrait of an original adult woman in a dim intimate dressing room or backstage area. Give her voluminous soft Hollywood waves with a feathered curtain fringe, natural flyaways, dreamy partially closed eyes, and dewy realistic skin. She wears an intricate red lace corset-style top with shimmering crimson sequins and small silver bead accents, paired with a matching layered ruffled sequin miniskirt with satin ribbon waistband, styled with secure opaque coverage. Her right arm holds a vintage compact silver camera at eye level while her left hand rests near the collarbone. Use warm hazy tungsten light, soft bloom, deep warm shadows, dark textured walls, blurred equipment cases and clothing racks, 35mm f/2 depth, Kodak Portra 400-inspired grain, crimson red, charcoal, and amber tones.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent lace, exposed underwear, nudity, celebrity identity, fetish framing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: source red backstage mirror reference
assets.usage: Use only for mirror composition, red wardrobe, dressing-room setting, light, and film treatment; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the red lace/sequin outfit, mirror camera prop, backstage setting, and warm 35mm glamour. Keep the subject original adult and clothing opaque and secure; background equipment may vary.

changes: Removed public-figure resemblance and specified an original adult subject.
Clarified secure opaque coverage while preserving the red glamour wardrobe and concept.
